definitions.explanation: The way something develops or unfolds over time.

examples.japanese: {病状|びょうじょう}の{経過|けいか}を{観察|かんさつ}する。
examples.english: To observe the progress of the illness.

examples.japanese: {事件|じけん}の{経過|けいか}を{説明|せつめい}する。
examples.english: To explain the course of the incident.

examples.japanese: {手術|しゅじゅつ}{後|ご}の{経過|けいか}は{良好|りょうこう}で、{来週|らいしゅう}{退院|たいいん}できる{見込|みこ}みだ。
examples.english: The post-operative progress is good, and he is expected to be discharged next week.

examples.japanese: {開始|かいし}から1{時間|じかん}が{経過|けいか}した。
examples.english: One hour has passed since the start.

examples.japanese: {時間|じかん}が{経過|けいか}するにつれて、{記憶|きおく}は{薄|うす}れていく。

notes:
{経過|けいか} has two main uses: describing how a situation develops over time (sense 1) and the simple passage of time (sense 2).

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {経過|けいか}を{見守|みまも}る: to watch how things develop
- {経過|けいか}{報告|ほうこく}: progress report
- {経過|けいか}{観察|かんさつ}: monitoring progress
- {時間|じかん}の{経過|けいか}: passage of time

VERB FORM:
{経過|けいか}する means 'to pass' or 'to elapse.' It is intransitive — time or a period is the subject.

USAGE:
Often used in medical and formal contexts: {術後|じゅつご}の{経過|けいか} (post-operative progress), {経過|けいか}{良好|りょうこう} (good progress). Also common in news and reports.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {過程|かてい}: process (focuses on steps/stages, not time)
- {推移|すいい}: transition, shift (focuses on changes in data or trends)
